question: Not 'does a dataset contain old depth charts' — it does. 'Can we prove, per game, what was knowable BEFORE that game's kickoff?'
consequence: The pregame availability margin candidate stays UNEVALUATED. Its one permitted look is still unspent. Nothing here relabels it, and no registration was created or amended — a registration with no admissible source would be paperwork.

candidates.probe: first line of depth_charts_<season>.csv, checked for a `dt` capture instant
candidates.note: 2025 is not the same feed with a column added — its whole schema differs (dt, team, player_name, espn_id, gsis_id, pos_grp_id...) against 2022-24's (season, club_code, week, game_type, depth_team...). nflverse changed the depth-chart pipeline for 2025, which is why only that season is stamped.
candidates.verdict: INSUFFICIENT — one of four seasons carries a capture instant

candidates.source: nflverse release asset timestamps as a proxy for capture time
candidates.probe: GitHub releases API, tag `depth_charts`, asset updated_at
candidates.note: The 2022 file was last rewritten in August 2024 — two years after the season it describes. An asset timestamp records when the file was rebuilt, not when any row was knowable, and a bulk rewrite carries no per-game ordering at all.
candidates.verdict: REFUTED — the timestamps postdate the seasons entirely

candidates.source: Internet Archive (Wayback) snapshots of a public depth-chart page
candidates.note: Ten of twelve captures in a 2.5-month window are 403s — the archive holds error pages, not depth charts. Satisfying the bar needs a pre-kickoff snapshot for BOTH teams of EVERY game; this is two usable captures for one team across a third of a season.
candidates.verdict: INSUFFICIENT — coverage is orders of magnitude short, and most of it is not content

whatWouldChangeThis: A depth-chart or availability source carrying a per-row capture instant for 2022-2025, or independent evidence of when each week-key was first published. A prospectively captured archive would also qualify in time — 2025 is already stamped, so the constraint is history, not the future.
pathsExplicitlyNotTaken: Scoring 2025 alone because it is the season whose timestamps are convenient — the registration's design is walk-forward across 2022-2025, and narrowing the span to what happens to be stamped is selecting on data availability.
Treating a week number as a capture instant.
Treating a post-season compiled depth chart as pregame knowledge.
Weakening the noLeakage bar so the candidate becomes scoreable.
incumbentStatus: nfl-margin-elo-hfa-v1 and nfl-win-elo-mov-v1 remain VALIDATED and UNCHANGED. Nothing in this search bears on their eligibility.
